{{Top|leg}}
[[File:WET-02_vapor_tanks.jpg|thumb|right|A WET-02 tank]]
'''WET-02 vapor tanks''' were devices used by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to keep their skin moist in open air environments. The tanks were installed in all Mon Calamari [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Hasbro Mon Cal">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Mon Calamari Officer|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjmoncalamari.asp}}</ref> Some of the tanks could be found on the bridge of [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']]''.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WET-02_vapor_tanks_Home_One.jpg|250px|thumb|WET-02 tanks on ''Home One'']]
These vapor tanks appeared on the bridge of ''Home One'' in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and in promotional photos for the film, behind the later-named [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] character [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack]]. They were not identified until [[2000]], within the "Jedi Force File" booklet packaged with the Mon Calamari Officer action figure from [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' toy line.
